review.technical: Real alpha audited; raw source preserved, no raster postprocessing. Profiles use region drawing and alpha cutout to suppress diffuse edges. Both weapon families and 3 place poses previewed.
review.visual: Helmet silhouette, muted coat, ochre shoulder and paired back modules kept. Hands remain uncovered to keep registered pose shape. Small rendered view checked; high magnification exposes source softness. Three place poses are static.
review.limitations: Not a released equippable outfit. Other 3 outfits have concept previews only. Galaxy and player motion preference untested. No idle walking sprite sheet or new gameplay rules.
